verdict: Nasi ayam is better for weight loss. It's about 200 kcal lower, even though the penyet has more protein.
why: Nasi ayam is about 600 kcal, a nasi ayam penyet set about 800 kcal.
The penyet has about 39 g fat compared to 23 g, from the fried chicken, oily sambal and fried side dishes.
The penyet has more protein, about 38 g compared to 28 g, because the chicken piece is usually bigger.
A penyet set usually comes with fried tofu, fried tempeh and sambal. It's easy to add calories without noticing.
when_a: Nasi ayam penyet is okay when you're really hungry, for example after an active day, and your other meals that day are lighter.
when_b: Nasi ayam suits a normal workday lunch with more controlled calories.
tip: For penyet, ask for half rice and eat more ulam (raw salad greens) or cucumber. For nasi ayam, choose roasted chicken and eat less of the skin.

faq.q: Is penyet sambal high in calories?
faq.a: Sambal has oil, so calories can add up. Take just enough for taste, no need to finish it all.

faq.q: Are the tofu and tempeh in a penyet set okay?
faq.a: Okay, both have protein. But they're fried, so if you want it lighter, eat just one of them.
